list.name: transaction
list.label: Transaction
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "jmeter" WITH KEY = "transaction"

panels.title: p95 - GET Posts API (actual + forecast + band)

targets.query: SELECT percentile("duration_ms",95) AS "actual_p95" FROM "jmeter" WHERE $timeFilter AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT "value" FROM "aiperf_forecast" WHERE $timeFilter AND "metric"='p95' AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT "upper" FROM "aiperf_forecast" WHERE $timeFilter AND "metric"='p95' AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT "lower" FROM "aiperf_forecast" WHERE $timeFilter AND "metric"='p95' AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: avg / p90 / p99 - GET Posts API (actual + forecast)

targets.query: SELECT mean("duration_ms") AS "avg" FROM "jmeter" WHERE $timeFilter AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT percentile("duration_ms",90) AS "p90" FROM "jmeter" WHERE $timeFilter AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT percentile("duration_ms",99) AS "p99" FROM "jmeter" WHERE $timeFilter AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT "value" FROM "aiperf_forecast" WHERE $timeFilter AND "metric" IN ('avg','p90','p99') AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval), "metric" fill(null)
SELECT mean("error_pct") AS "error_pct" FROM "jmeter" WHERE $timeFilter AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT "value" FROM "aiperf_forecast" WHERE $timeFilter AND "metric"='error_pct' AND "transaction"='GET Posts API' GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT "message", "severity", "value", "expected_lower", "expected_upper" FROM "aiperf_alerts" WHERE $timeFilter AND "severity"='CRITICAL' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT "trend_pct", "slope_per_day", "r2" FROM "aiperf_trend_analysis" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "transaction" ORDER BY "trend_pct" DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT percentile("duration_ms",95) AS "p95" FROM "jmeter" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "transaction" fill(null)
SELECT "value" FROM "aiperf_forecast" WHERE $timeFilter AND "metric"='p95' GROUP BY time($__interval), "transaction" fill(null)
